title: MAC Minute — 2026-10-02
description: Happy Friday morning, MAC Fellas, and welcome to October second. Let's dive straight into the latest market shifts, starting with flydubai Cargo launching scheduled freighter operations with three Boeing 737-800s. They are targeting regional demand and e-commerce growth that narrowbody belly capacity just cannot fully cover. Meanwhile, widebody freighter fleets are expanding too, with Ethiopian Airlines ordering ten Boeing 777F jets. And Silk Way West added two Airbus A350F freighters to their pipeline. A busy week for dedicated capacity investments. Watch how these regional and widebody expansions shape global trade lanes next. Have a great weekend, everyone.
